mouth parameter samples correlated with real playback task
live2d.missing_evidence_policy: Record unavailable model/mouth evidence explicitly; do not infer loaded model or lip sync from model asset HTTP 200.

measurement_limits.baseline_quality_cpu_overlap: Must annotate comparable final samples individually; do not claim clean-start speedup from baseline with quality CPU overlap.

same_session_continuity.execution: Reuse the supported authenticated role/live Socket.IO probe if it can retain one socket and one logical graph session cheaply. Preserve persona, actor role and audience across both turns.
same_session_continuity.performance_prompt: Keep baseline role performance prompt for the measured first dialogue; perform separate continuity turns afterward rather than modifying timing prompt.
same_session_continuity.unique_code: Generate one ordinary unique acceptance code for this task at execution and persist the exact code with raw evidence.
same_session_continuity.turn_1: Tell the role the unique acceptance code. Capture actual request, server graph task/thread identifiers and actual reply.
same_session_continuity.turn_2: Ask what the acceptance code just given was; omit the code from this question. Capture actual response and compare it against the exact first-turn code.
evidence: same socket connection and logical session/thread identity
raw sent text and actual received replies for both turns
exact task IDs and graph evidence
expected code versus actual recalled reply
available live persistent playback state/task ID/count for each round
same_session_continuity.success_criteria: Actual second reply recalls the first-turn code in the same session; no mock/synthetic replies or code supplied in follow-up.
same_session_continuity.missing_or_failure_policy: Record inability to retain session, timeout or incorrect recall honestly with original evidence; do not retry terminal failures by making a new lifecycle run.
same_session_continuity.memory_mode: Preserve production long_term_memory_mode=off. This proves only short-term session continuity, not durable long-term writes.
